blind.description: A dungeon wall trap module featuring a heavy greenish-bronze or mossy stone frame with corner pillars and a top beam. The front face contains a recessed panel set with a 4x3 grid of twelve sculpted gargoyle or grotesque faces, each with a gaping open mouth serving as a dart/arrow port. The base is supported by stepped stone blocks. The rear side consists of three plain horizontal stone slabs within the frame. All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and textured with stylized weathered stone.
blind.from_above: A horizontal framed rectangle with wider pillar caps at both ends, showing four protruding relief face crests on the front edge and stepped foundation blocks below.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 5 ft 3 in tall) and approximately 4 to 4.5 ft wide.
